<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/v1/transfer-approvals"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Takes a proposal snapshot (origin, destination, SKU, quantity, policy
version) and validates it against the CURRENT fail-closed read
models. On success the InterWarehouseTransfer saga persists through
PROPOSED → APPROVED → ALLOCATING and, in the same transaction,
enqueue TransferPlanApproved and TransferAllocationRequested into the
transactional outbox; a relay publishes them to Kafka and
inventory-storage's reply later drives the transfer to ALLOCATED or
UNFULFILLABLE. Idempotent per the required Idempotency-Key header:
replaying the same key with the same request replays the ORIGINAL
answer (header Idempotency-Replayed: true); the same key with a
different request is a 409 idempotency-key-reused. Fail-closed validation failures return 422: the origin or the
destination is missing or stale in the planning snapshot (the problem
detail names the site and the stale fact), is disabled for its role, or
the demand and capacity checks fail. Stale facts of any other site do
not matter. When no site has complete fresh facts at all the answer is
the same 422 facts-incomplete; unusable (unreadable) read models
return 503. Other 422 problem types: invalid-approval (the request
fails the use case's checks), below-one-case (the origin cannot send
one whole case of a CASE-level SKU) and proposal-expired. Other 503
types: saga-unavailable (no saga persistence), config-incomplete
(TRANSFER_PICK_PATH_ID / TRANSFER_PICK_CPT_OFFSET unset),
pack-levels-unavailable and approval-unavailable. A body with an
unknown field or malformed JSON is 400 invalid-request. 2xx and 4xx
answers are stored and replayed; a 5xx is never stored.
